title: 5 Dragons vs 1 Chess YouTuber
summary: Same format as the jacksark video: Tony (full army, White) vs chess YouTuber ViperKing, who has only a king plus N Dragons (bishop + knight), adding one dragon after each Tony win until Tony loses. Goal stated: survive/beat him up to five dragons. Tony wins with 1, 2, 3 (~11:10), 4 ... dragons and finally loses to seven dragons (mated on h2, ~38:16).
rules: Opponent: king + N Dragons (N starts at 1). Player: full standard army as White.
After each player win, +1 dragon for the opponent; ends when the player loses (lost at 7).
win_condition: Beat the dragon side at least up to 5 dragons (stated goal); run ends on first loss.

board.theme_notes: brown lichess-style board, flipped in frames; webcam overlay; 5:00 clocks

setup: Player: standard army (White). Opponent: Ke8 + N dragons on the back rank (positions visual-only).
current_impl_issues: Impl gives the PLAYER king + 5 dragons vs a full army; the video gives the OPPONENT king + dragons (1..7) vs the player's full army, incrementing after each player win.
